portal_hypertension.title: Value of Albumin Bilirubin and Platelet Albumin Bilirubin scores in predicting the outcome of portal hypertension-related acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding in cirrhotic patients.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ghait SS, K Abdel Wahab A, M El Saeed K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝硬化中门脉高压相关的急性上消化道出血（AUGIB）具有很高的发病率和死亡率，需要客观的早期风险分层工具。 临床提示：评估 ALBI 和 PALBI 评分对出现 AUGIB 的肝硬化患者的预测价值。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension-related acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding (AUGIB) in cirrhosis carries high morbidity and mortality, requiring objective early risk-stratification tools. The Albumin-Bilirubin (ALBI) and Platelet-Albumin-Bilirubin (PALBI) scores have been proposed as prognostic markers. To assess the predictive value of ALBI and PALBI scores in cirrhotic patients presenting with AUGIB. A prospective cohort of 100 cirrhotic patients admitted with AUGIB to Ain Shams University Hospitals was evaluated.
